subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands be solved with explicit account-level nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or documented as unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: Current main has no account-level naming contract, the two unmerged PRs show a real design fork, and adding either option expands Slack config and setup behavior.

options.title: Implement validated nativeNames
options.body: Add one explicit per-account mapping surface with Slack command-name validation, collision checks, registration/reverse lookup support, docs, and tests.

options.title: Implement constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar with strict lowercase slug validation and no broad dash-stripping fallback, accepting simpler setup but a second naming abstraction.

options.title: Document duplicate native names as unsupported
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical OpenClaw native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement validated nativeNames
recommendation.body: Add one explicit per-account mapping surface with Slack command-name validation, collision checks, registration/reverse lookup support, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest current and historical code trail for Slack native names and the shared command registry points to steipete.
